paragraphs: Norway is mourning the death of King Harald V, who passed away at the age of 89 after a 35-year reign. He was Europe’s oldest monarch and became widely loved for modernizing the monarchy.

Over the decades, he broke traditions by marrying a commoner, Queen Sonja, and by serving as a compassionate voice of national unity. King Harald supported minorities, migrants, and the LGBTQ+ community, and was famous for his inclusive speeches emphasizing that all people belong to modern Norway. He also provided comfort to the nation during tragedies, such as the 2011 terror attacks.

Following his passing, his son succeeded to the throne as King Haakon VIII without a coronation ceremony. Despite recent scandals within the royal family and growing public debate surrounding the institution, Norwegians remember King Harald V as an empathetic, grandfatherly figure who successfully adapted the monarchy to a modern democratic society.

paragraphs: Norwegians are sad because King Harald V died at the age of 89. He was the king of Norway for 35 years and was very popular.

People loved him because he was kind, warm, and brought the country together. He welcomed immigrants and supported the LGBTQ+ community. After his death, his son became the new King Haakon VIII. The new king promised to serve his country using his father’s motto: Everything for Norway.

Even though there were some recent scandals in the royal family, many people in Norway still love their monarchy. They will remember King Harald V as a caring leader and a grandfather figure for the whole nation.

paragraphs: King Harald V of Norway dies. He is 89 years old. He is king for 35 years.
